data.description:
## Context
Three genuine Gerrit Verify runs assign an almost identical setup duration to tests/unit/workflow/test_editor.py::test_server_binds_loopback_only: 35.06s before static Pandoc replay and 35.09s in both post-static-corpus patch sets. Focused test/module runs are subsecond/2.44s; targeted editor setup instrumentation was below 4ms; a 10,000-directory APFS tmp_path benchmark stayed below 3.4ms. Recurrence after removing complete Pandoc subprocess replay rejects the prior generic worker-starvation account. CPython ThreadingHTTPServer construction synchronously calls socket.getfqdn(host), which performs reverse DNS even for numeric 127.0.0.1, making a fixed macOS resolver timeout the leading dynamic hypothesis. Existing pytest durations identify only the aggregate setup phase, so one organic CI observation needs nested timing before changing behavior.

## Plan
- Add a thresholded pytest fixture-setup observer that emits worker id, node id, fixture name, and monotonic elapsed time only for fixture spans above one second.
- Add transparent, semantics-preserving timing around the editor server constructor, TCP bind, and socket.getfqdn call during the _server fixture; emit only spans above one second and preserve original arguments, return values, and exceptions.
- Keep output quiet outside CI/explicit opt-in and avoid any new dependency or external call.
- Prove locally that the observer names the correct nested span using deterministic delayed fakes, then run the focused editor and observability tests.
- Land through Gerrit and use the first organic macOS/Ubuntu full-route run as the discriminating experiment. H1 predicts ~35s in getfqdn(127.0.0.1) on macOS with bind milliseconds; H2 predicts the inverse; H3 predicts the time belongs to _no_repo_commits rather than _server.
- Record the confirmed mechanism and create a linked RED/GREEN fix ticket only after runtime evidence discriminates the hypotheses. Back out with a Gerrit revert if instrumentation changes test semantics or produces noisy routine logs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Fixture spans above one second identify worker, node, fixture, and elapsed seconds.
- [ ] Editor server setup separately measures constructor, TCP bind, and getfqdn without changing their behavior.
- [ ] Instrumentation is silent below threshold and outside CI/explicit opt-in.
- [ ] Deterministic tests prove each discriminating span is attributed correctly.
- [ ] Focused editor tests and broader test-observability guards pass.
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, action/workflow policy gates pass as applicable.
- [ ] Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 are recorded before merge.
- [ ] The first organic post-merge macOS/Ubuntu observation is recorded.
- [ ] A confirmed root cause or explicit inconclusive experiment result is written back before close.
data.title: Instrument recurring 35-second macOS editor setup long pole
